changelog:
A live channel whose provider closes the stream now reconnects instead of freezing, and multi-view explains a provider's stream limit.

WHAT CHANGED

- When a provider closes a live stream, the player and every multi-view cell now reconnect by themselves and say "The provider closed the connection. Reconnecting…". Before, the picture stayed on its last frame with no message.
- Multi-view: when the cells ask a provider for more streams than it reports allowing, a note under the bar explains the interruptions you may see, and the channel picker marks channels whose provider is at its limit. The note never stops a cell, and it does not come back for a provider you have already dismissed it for until the grid is within every limit again.
- A recording that needs a connection the multi-view cells are using now closes as many cells as it needs, the ones without sound first, and the grid names the channels that closed so you can put them back afterwards.
- An M3U playlist from a slow provider now waits as long as Settings, Wait for a provider's list says (3 minutes unless you changed it), instead of giving up after 45 seconds.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything from 0.5.13: multi-view with one cell playing sound, full screen and back, and each layout remembered; casting to the television, recording, and pause and rewind on live TV.
